stem:
Sana tests an unknown liquid with both litmus papers.
Blue litmus turns red. Red litmus stays red.

parts.text: How should she classify the liquid?

options.text: Acidic — blue litmus turns red and red litmus stays red.
Basic — blue litmus turns red and red litmus stays red.
Neutral — one litmus paper changed colour, so the liquid is neither acidic nor basic.
Acidic and basic — both papers were used, so both labels apply.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Acids turn blue litmus red and leave red litmus red.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue litmus to red with red litmus unchanged means the liquid is acidic.
